verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents idempotency, rate limits, API keys, webhooks and an MCP server, but nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy. The MCP server's mention of 'latest versions of the API reference' concerns documentation freshness, not versioned endpoints or sunset timelines, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
